Osnabrück Jewish Community Synagogue

Synagogue · Osnabrück, Germany

The Jüdische Gemeinde Osnabrück is based at In der Barlage 41–43, where it maintains its synagogue and community center. The community’s official website and current municipal information identify the site as the Synagogue Osnabrück and document ongoing Jewish communal and religious activity. The center was expanded in 2010 and serves a unified community whose members come from varied Jewish backgrounds. An exact inauguration year for the present synagogue was not added because it was not verified from the selected sources.
